name: delete
description: Represents a delete or discard action. On hover, the bin lid swings open on a hinge at its left corner (-25°, spring easing) — ready to receive the deleted item. On press, the whole icon scales down to 0.92 confirming the destructive action. Lid closes on hover-leave.

animation.description: The lid path is separated from the bin body and rotates -25° around its left-bottom hinge point (SVG coords 4,6) on hover — 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) spring overshoot. The whole icon scales to 0.92 on press (100ms easeOut). Both reverse on hover-leave / pointer-up. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Destructive actions must have a confirmation step or be reversible. The icon alone does not communicate permanence — the surrounding UI must.
